The theorem makes no unsupported infinite-enumeration or global-orbit inference.

originality.rationale: The primary Paarporn manuscript, arXiv:2311.02745v1, gives the same bilinear logit/environment vector field and local Hopf linearization, explicitly leaving the first Lyapunov coefficient and cycle stability for future work (Section IV-A and Conclusion). The source is not already the derived nonlinear coefficient. Three closely adjacent full manuscripts were inspected: one static logit model and two environmental replicator/replicator-mutator models, which do not calculate the bilinear logit coefficient or imply the new all-timescale and sign-reversal classifications. Multiple semantic and exact-phrase searches in the public mathematical-result index returned no covering logit-feedback result; nearest records were compared on equations and implications. This is qualified literature-based originality with an explicitly recorded residual index risk, not proof of universal priority.

value.rationale: The motivating 2023 logit-feedback study explicitly leaves exact first-Lyapunov stability conditions unresolved. This theorem yields a complete exact criticality criterion for the full bilinear logit–environment family, proves stability robust under all positive environmental timescales in its published Figure-3 model, and constructs admissible payoffs with a sharp opposite criticality when ecological timescale changes. The latter contrasts demonstrate a structural boundary in behavioral/resource coupling; this is not just an arbitrary numerical example or a generic textbook formula.
